decision_rule: smallest of {rating-100-v1 (50 clusters x 1 rep), rating-120-v1 (60 x 1), rating-240-v1 (60 x 2), rating-360-v1 (60 x 3)} per anchor per batch whose simulated P(all three lower bounds > 2000) >= 0.80 at a true 2,100 Elo alternative under 1.5x cluster-SD inflation (250,000 deterministic replicates); fixed in PREREGISTRATION.md 2026-11-25 before the SCREEN-E3 evidence was played
limitations: Delta-method normal approximation over measured covariances; the registered opening-cluster bootstrap remains the final evidence method. Power at alternatives below 2,100 Elo is lower by construction: a true rating near the threshold can yield INCONCLUSIVE, which is fail-closed and never partial credit. Screening runs used one paired repetition per opening; the design's cluster-mean variances at higher repetitions derive from the measured variance components.

excluded_openings.rule: complete-case cluster exclusion: a cluster lacking its counted AB/BA pair in any input is dropped from all inputs (analysis-only; committed evidence untouched)

screening_inputs.note: Selection and power inputs only; never gate evidence.
